+"""
+Test that ModelForm RadioSelect widget for foreign keys does not present
+a blank option when blank=False on the model.
+"""
+from django import forms
+from django.db import models
+from django.template import Context, Template
+from django.test import TestCase
+from django.forms import ModelForm, RadioSelect
+
+from tests.model_forms.models import Author
+
+
+class TestModelChoiceFieldRadioSelectBlankFalse(TestCase):
+    """
+    Test that a ForeignKey field with blank=False uses RadioSelect widget
+    without a blank option.
+
+    Unlike the select widget, where a blank option is idiomatic even for
+    required fields, radioselect has an inherent unfilled state that makes
+    the "-------" option look suspiciously like a valid choice.
+    """
+
+    def test_radioselect_no_blank_option_for_required_field(self):
+        """
+        ModelForm RadioSelect widget for foreign keys should not present
+        a blank option if blank=False on the model.
+        """
+        class TestRun(models.Model):
+            data_file = models.ForeignKey(
+                Author, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=False
+            )
+
+        class TestRunForm(ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = TestRun
+                fields = ['data_file']
+                widgets = {'data_file': RadioSelect()}
+
+        form = TestRunForm()
+        field = form['data_file']
+        choices = list(field.choices)
+
+        # There should be no blank option (empty string value)
+        blank_options = [c for c in choices if c[0] == '' or c[0] is None]
+        self.assertEqual(len(blank_options), 0,
+                         "RadioSelect should not have a blank option for required fields")
+
+    def test_radioselect_no_blank_option_for_required_field_with_existing_instance(self):
+        """
+        RadioSelect should also not present a blank option when editing
+        an existing instance with a required ForeignKey.
+        """
+        class TestRun(models.Model):
+            data_file = models.ForeignKey(
+                Author, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=False
+            )
+
+        class TestRunForm(ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = TestRun
+                fields = ['data_file']
+                widgets = {'data_file': RadioSelect()}
+
+        # Create a test instance
+        author = Author.objects.create(name='Test Author')
+        instance = TestRun.objects.create(data_file=author)
+
+        form = TestRunForm(instance=instance)
+        field = form['data_file']
+        choices = list(field.choices)
+
+        # There should be no blank option
+        blank_options = [c for c in choices if c[0] == '' or c[0] is None]
+        self.assertEqual(len(blank_options), 0,
+                         "RadioSelect should not have a blank option for required fields")
+
+    def test_radioselect_blank_option_for_optional_field(self):
+        """
+        RadioSelect should present a blank option when blank=True on the model.
+        """
+        class OptionalRun(models.Model):
+            data_file = models.ForeignKey(
+                Author, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True
+            )
+
+        class OptionalRunForm(ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = OptionalRun
+                fields = ['data_file']
+                widgets = {'data_file': RadioSelect()}
+
+        form = OptionalRunForm()
+        field = form['data_file']
+        choices = list(field.choices)
+
+        # There should be a blank option
+        blank_options = [c for c in choices if c[0] == '' or c[0] is None]
+        self.assertEqual(len(blank_options), 1,
+                         "RadioSelect should have a blank option for optional fields")
+
+    def test_radioselect_render_html_no_checked_blank_option(self):
+        """
+        When rendering a new form with RadioSelect for a required field,
+        there should be no checked blank option in the HTML output.
+        """
+        class TestRun(models.Model):
+            data_file = models.ForeignKey(
+                Author, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=False
+            )
+
+        class TestRunForm(ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = TestRun
+                fields = ['data_file']
+                widgets = {'data_file': RadioSelect()}
+
+        form = TestRunForm()
+        template = Template('{{ form.data_file }}')
+        rendered = template.render(Context({'form': form}))
+
+        # Should not have a checked blank option
+        self.assertNotIn('checked="checked"', rendered)
+        self.assertNotIn('checked="true"', rendered)
+
+        # Should have some radio options with values (the actual choices)
+        self.assertIn('<li>', rendered)
+        self.assertIn('name="data_file"', rendered)
+
+
+class TestRadioSelectWithAutoId(TestCase):
+    """
+    Test that RadioSelect works correctly with auto_id for required fields.
+    """
+
+    def test_radioselect_auto_id_render(self):
+        """
+        RadioSelect with auto_id should render correctly without
+        a checked blank option for required fields.
+        """
+        class TestRun(models.Model):
+            data_file = models.ForeignKey(
+                Author, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=False
+            )
+
+        class TestRunForm(ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = TestRun
+                fields = ['data_file']
+                widgets = {'data_file': RadioSelect()}
+
+        form = TestRunForm(auto_id='id_')
+        template = Template('{{ form.data_file }}')
+        rendered = template.render(Context({'form': form}))
+
+        # Should not have a checked blank option
+        self.assertNotIn('checked="checked"', rendered)
+        self.assertNotIn('checked="true"', rendered)
